# Copilot instructions

TaskFlow is a small task tracker. The frontend is in `web/` and the backend is in `api/`.

Use TypeScript for the frontend and Python for the backend. Try to write clean code and add tests when you can.

<!--
NOTE: This file is intentionally thin and generic. It doesn't yet reflect how THIS
team actually works, so Copilot can't follow conventions it doesn't know about.
You'll turn it into an effective, team-wide instruction set in Module 1.
-->
